title: Product Categories
description: Learn how to organize your products using categories and subcategories for better navigation and management.
content:
Product Categories

Categories help organize your products, making them easier for customers to find and for you to manage. This guide covers creating and managing product categories.

Why Use Categories?

Categories provide:

  • Better product organization
  • Improved customer navigation
  • Easier inventory management
  • Better SEO structure
  • Enhanced shopping experience

Creating Categories

To create a category:

  1. Navigate to Categories in the sidebar
  2. Click Create Category or New Category
  3. Fill in category information:
    • Category Name: Display name
    • Slug: URL-friendly identifier
    • Description: Category description
    • Image: Category image
    • Parent Category: For subcategories
  4. Configure SEO settings
  5. Click Save

Parent and Child Categories

Create hierarchical category structures:

  • Parent Categories: Top-level categories
  • Child Categories: Subcategories under parents
  • Multi-level: Subcategories can have subcategories

Example Structure

  • Electronics (Parent)
    • Phones (Child)
      • Smartphones (Grandchild)
      • Feature Phones (Grandchild)
    • Laptops (Child)
    • Tablets (Child)

Assigning Products to Categories

To assign products:

  1. Edit a product
  2. Find the Category section
  3. Select one or more categories
  4. Save the product

Note: Products can belong to multiple categories.

Category Images

Add images to categories:

  • Use high-quality images
  • Recommended size: 800x600px
  • Optimize for web (compress images)
  • Use descriptive filenames

Category Descriptions

Write effective category descriptions:

  • Describe the products in the category
  • Use relevant keywords for SEO
  • Keep descriptions concise but informative
  • Include call-to-action if appropriate

Category Organization

Sorting Categories

Organize categories by:

  • Alphabetical order
  • Custom order
  • Product count

Featured Categories

Mark important categories as featured:

  • Featured categories appear prominently
  • Show on homepage
  • Highlight in navigation

SEO for Categories

Optimize categories for search engines:

  • Meta Title: Category page title
  • Meta Description: Description for search results
  • Keywords: Relevant keywords
  • URL Slug: SEO-friendly URL

Managing Categories

Editing Categories

  1. Go to Categories list
  2. Click on a category
  3. Make changes
  4. Save

Deleting Categories

To delete a category:

  1. Select the category
  2. Click Delete
  3. Confirm deletion

Note: Products in deleted categories will be uncategorized. Assign them to other categories first.

Bulk Operations

Perform bulk actions:

  • Delete multiple categories
  • Update category status
  • Export category list

Category Display

Categories appear:

  • In navigation menus
  • On homepage
  • In category pages
  • In search results
  • In product listings

Best Practices

  • Keep category names clear and descriptive
  • Limit hierarchy depth (2-3 levels recommended)
  • Use consistent naming conventions
  • Don't create too many categories
  • Regularly review and clean up categories

Next Steps

After organizing categories:

  • Add products to categories
  • Manage inventory by category
